profile.ja: 五車の外縁部の片隅に居を構える盆戸家の当主。家の格は大きく違うが、ふうまと同じ学生当主である。代々海外とのかかわりが強い家で、鎖国時代には南蛮の技術を取り込む窓口のような役割をしていたという。他国との交流が増えた現代でも、米連や中華連合と独自のパイプを持っている。そんな家柄から異国との婚姻も多く、閉鎖的な前時代には余所者扱いされることも少なくなかったため、盆戸家の子息は生まれた時から古風な武家としての教育を施された。麻里亜もその教育を受けて育ち、古式ゆかしい大和撫子の振る舞いを身に着け、茶道や華道にも造詣が深く、和服を普段着としている。そしてひとたび戦場へと出れば、愛用の忍者刀を勇ましく振り回して武功を上げる。しかし切り札は西洋剣術で、金遁の術で忍者刀を細剣（レイピア）へと変えて敵を翻弄する。これは彼女独自のものではなく、表向きには武家らしく振る舞い、しかし異国から得たものも忘れないという家訓によるもの。
profile.en: She is the head of the Bondo family, whose estate lies in a corner of the outer edge of Gosha. Though her family's standing differs greatly, she is a student headmaster like Fuuma. For generations the Bondo have had strong overseas ties; during the sakoku period they acted as a gateway for Southern barbarian technology. Even today, with increased foreign exchange, they maintain their own pipelines with the United States Union and the Chinese Federation. Because of this lineage, many marriages to foreigners occurred, and in the closed-off earlier era the Bondo children were often treated as outsiders, so they were educated from birth in the traditional ways of a samurai household. Maria received that upbringing, adopting the refined manner of a classic Yamato nadeshiko, and is well-versed in tea ceremony and flower arranging, wearing kimono as everyday attire. When she steps onto the battlefield she brandishes her beloved ninja sword with vigor, but her trump card is Western swordsmanship: using the Golden-Escape technique she transforms her ninja blade into a rapier to bewilder her foes. This follows the family creed of appearing as a proper samurai while never forgetting what she has learned from foreign lands.

text.ja: 盆戸家当主、盆戸麻里亜です。要請に応じて参上しました。同じ当主としても、よろしくお願いしますね
text.en: I am Maria Bondo, head of the Bondo family. I've answered your request and arrived. Even as a fellow head, I look forward to working with you.

text.ja: この瞳と髪の色を見て米連の者だと判断されることは多いです。だからこそ、他国に取り入るのは得意なのです。物は使いようですね
text.en: People often assume I'm from the US Union just by looking at my eyes and hair color. That's exactly why I'm good at adapting to other nations. It's all about how you use what you have.

text.ja: 家を守り抜くのが当主の務め。たとえ余所者だと罵られ続けようとも……ここまで受け継がれてきた誇りは、私が後世に繋いでみせます
text.en: Protecting the family is the head's duty. Even if I'm constantly called an outsider… the pride that has been passed down to this point, I'll carry it into the future.

text.ja: お茶を点てて振る舞い、言葉を交わす。そう斬り結ぶことなく争いが解決して欲しいと願ってしまうのは、私が未熟だからなのでしょうか
text.en: Serving tea and sharing conversation—I wish conflicts could be resolved without cutting them down. Is that because I'm still inexperienced?

text.ja: えぇ、普段着も和服です。慣れないと動きにくいと思われるでしょうが、非常に快適ですよ。あなたもたまには和装で過ごされてはいかが？
text.en: Yes, I wear kimono as everyday clothes. You might think it's restrictive if you're not used to it, but it's actually very comfortable. Why don't you try wearing traditional clothing once in a while?

text.ja: 弟は私に残された、たった一人の家族……何ものにも代え難い存在です。あの子が大きくなるまでは、私がしっかりと導いてあげなくては
text.en: My younger brother is the only family I have left… an irreplaceable treasure. Until he grows up, I must guide him properly.

text.ja: はい、私のこの忍者刀は金遁の術によって細剣……つまりレイピアへと変容します。ですが簡単にはお見せできません、奥の手ですから
text.en: Indeed, my ninja sword transforms into a rapier via the Golden-Escape technique. But I can't just show it to you easily; it's my trump card.

text.ja: 私の中に流れる異邦人の血と日本人の血。どちらも紛れもなく私の一部だからこそ、常に忘れることなく振る舞っていたいのです
text.en: The foreign blood and Japanese blood that flow within me are both undeniably part of me, so I always strive to act without forgetting either.

text.ja: や、やめなさいっ、私を、そんな……くっ……あああぁッ！　い、いっそ殺しなさい……！　んはぁぁっ！　ち、違う、今の声は……！
text.en: Stop… stop it, don't… you…! Gah… Ahhh! …just… kill me…! Nhaa…! No, that voice just now…!

text.ja: ふーー、ふーーー、その程度、ですか……体をいくら汚しても、魂までは……あ゛っ、ぐ……はああぁ、ああああああぁ！
text.en: Fuu… fuu… is that all…? No matter how much I soil my body, my soul… ah… g… haa… ahhh!

text.ja: やだっ、やだやだやあぁあああっ！　ゆるしてええぇ、麻里亜、もう気持ちいいのイヤ――　あ゛！？　あ゛あああぁ、イグううううう！
text.en: No… no, nooo! P-please, Maria, I don't want this feeling any more—! Ah! Ahhh, I'm…!
